summary: Full backend and frontend re-testing of Bahi Khata after role reference fixes. All 23 backend tests pass. All frontend flows verified: admin login, dashboard with role greeting, Illaka/Misal management, Team management, Client list, Client detail with Illaka/Misal (not Branch), Approve/Reject/Pending buttons, sidebar navigation role-based items.

issues: 'New KYC' button visible in header on Clients page for admin - admin should not be able to create KYCs per business logic (only muneem/sipahi). The button exists at top-right of clients list for all roles. This may be intentional (UI nav shortcut) but logically inconsistent.

action_items: Consider hiding 'New KYC' button in clients list header for admin/maalik roles (currently visible but clicking leads to KYC form which is role-gated on submit)
Test data cleanup: Multiple TEST_Illaka_Central duplicates in DB from test runs - may want to clean up
critical_code_review_comments: KYC creation is correctly gated (403) at API level for admin - only muneem/sipahi can create. UI 'New KYC' button in client list header may confuse admin users.
Old test data with 'field_officer' role still exists in DB - leftover from iteration 1 before role refactor. Not a bug but stale data.
server.py at ~665 lines - approaching the 700-line limit recommended for splitting
seed_data_creation: Created UI_Test_Illaka, multiple TEST_Illaka_Central illakas and TEST_Misal_1 entries during testing. Several TEST_ sipahi/muneem users created and deactivated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All APIs working: /api/illakas, /api/misals, /api/kycs, /api/dashboard/stats (includes sipahi_count), /api/users. Role hierarchy admin->maalik->muneem->sipahi fully implemented. KYC creation requires muneem/sipahi role (403 for admin). Dashboard greeting shows 'Administrator/Maalik (Owner)/Muneem (Senior Agent)/Sipahi (Field Agent)'. Sidebar: admin/maalik see Illakas+Team, muneem/sipahi see New KYC. Client detail shows Illaka/Misal (not Branch). Approve/Reject/Pending buttons visible for admin. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_bahikhata.py with 23 tests all passing.
